name: Soba Noodle Soup with Tofu, Edamame, Mushroom, Green Onion & Ginger
ingredients: 64 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms and place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, ginger, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are lightly browned, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut tofu into ½-inch cubes.
When the mushrooms are done, add broth to the pot and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.

Once the broth is boiling, add tofu, noodles, edamame, and soy sauce; stir to combine the soup. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and continue to cook until noodles are tender and tofu is warmed through, 5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the soup and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
